lines.en: Hi Omar! Would you like to come to my birthday party on Friday?
Thank you for inviting me. I would love to come.
What do you think about my new apartment?
In my opinion, it is great. The living room is big.
We live in a small apartment, but the neighbors are friendly.
I have been living here for three years too.
Please take off your shoes before you come in.
Sure. Could you turn on the air conditioner, please?
Of course. The washing machine is not working again, by the way.
Don't worry, we can fix this together.
What should I do if the problem comes back?
Let's ask the manager. Maybe he has a solution.
Every problem has a solution if you stay calm.
I lost my keys yesterday, and I couldn't find them anywhere.
Oh no! Last summer, I went to Alexandria with my family.
It was raining when we arrived at the hotel, wasn't it?
Yes! Then we walked along the beach for an hour.
Suddenly, my little brother fell into the water.
Luckily, he was fine, and everyone laughed.
In the end, it was the best trip of the year.
I think this movie is better than the book. What do you think?
I agree with you, but I see it a little differently.
Honestly, I prefer tea to coffee. Maybe next time we go out.
That's an interesting point. Can I bring a friend with me?
Yes, please let me know if you can make it.
What time should I be there?
Come at seven. We are having a small dinner at our place tonight.
It was very kind of you to invite us.
Everyone has a different opinion, and that is fine.
Home is the place where I feel relaxed.
Okay, I have to go now. See you on Friday!
See you, Sara! Thanks again.
